_note: Listen-and-do lessons linked to A1 course objectives (PLN2 kids test, plan §2, owner choice: write matching lessons). extraWords: A1 words allowed in these lessons beyond the Starters list (only for a lesson that lists this outcome).

EN-F-A1-VO-days-months.focus: days and months: say and spell the full names (Wednesday, February); name a month, never number it (in May, not in month five)

EN-F-A1-GR-article-a-an.focus: a or an before one thing: a cat, a book, an apple, an egg, an orange; never a bare singular noun ("I have apple")

EN-F-A1-GR-capitals-full-stops.focus: a sentence starts with a capital letter and ends with a full stop; names and I always have a capital (Tom. Anna. I.)

EN-F-A1-VO-food-drink.focus: we eat food and soup (with a spoon); we drink water, milk, juice (from a cup or glass); never "drink soup"

EN-F-A1-VO-numbers-time.focus: number words with f and v right: five, fifteen; an hour is time, a clock is the thing on the wall (one hour, not one clock)

EN-F-A1-GR-article-the.focus: the for a thing we already know: "Tom has a ball. The ball is red."

EN-F-A1-GR-prepositions-time.focus: at + clock time (at ten o'clock), on + day (on Monday), in + month (in May)

EN-F-A1-GR-can-ability.focus: can + verb with no -s for every person: she can swim, he can jump (never "can swims")

EN-F-A1-GR-copula-be.focus: am / is / are in every present sentence: I am, he is, she is, they are (never "she happy", never "they is")
